quarterly_data.signal: Intel's 10-K: DCAI revenue increased $794 million (5%) in 2025 from 2024, primarily due to higher server revenue from higher hyperscale customer-related demand, which contributed to a 9% increase in server volume, while server ASPs decreased 4%. 2025 server revenue was limited in Q4 2025 by available supply due to Intel Foundry wafer fabrication supply constraints, primarily on the Intel 7 and Intel 3 process nodes; Intel expects these constraints to persist into 2026, with the most severe impact in Q1 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: DCAI revenue +$794 million (+5%, 2025 vs 2024); server volume +9%; server ASPs -4%; Intel 7 / Intel 3 wafer supply constraints most severe in Q1 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Intel's 10-K: Intel Foundry recorded $849 million of higher 2025 intersegment inventory reserves (lower of cost or net realizable value charges) for products manufactured on the early ramp of the Intel 18A process node. Company-wide (consolidated gross profit), 2025 inventory reserves were $878 million higher, primarily for the same early-ramp Intel 18A products. Intel Foundry's operating loss was $13.3 billion in 2024; the 2025 loss was smaller, primarily because of a reduction in asset impairments and accelerated depreciation charges.
quarterly_data.figure: $849 million higher 2025 intersegment inventory reserves on early-ramp Intel 18A products (company-wide $878 million); Intel Foundry operating loss $13.3 billion (2024)
